cases.spec_ref: The canonical AGS4 form of a 3SF-of-zero cell (GRAT_SIZE) is `"0.00"` — n significant figures, rendered by `ags4_str`. Every surface re-emits it identically; this is the reference the Excel round-trip is measured against.

to_excel → from_excel SHOULD preserve the bytes, but Excel's numeric formatter (`NumericFormat::format`) renders 3SF-of-zero `"0"`, not `"0.00"` — a documented, accepted lossiness (owner ruling: leave Excel; it is the python-ags4 import canonicaliser, gated at the formatter level by #517). The single-cell divergence is pinned `by-design` in xcheck-allow.json.
